name: Autel Intelligent Technology Corp., Ltd.
summary: Autel Intelligent Technology Corp., Ltd. provides smart vehicle diagnostics and smart charging solutions in China, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers diagnostic tools, key programming products, specialty tools, radar sensors, electric vehicle chargers, TPMS series products, wheel alignment and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) calibration products. The company also provides battery services; software update solutions; and cloud-based services. It primarily sells its products to approximately 50 countries and regions, including the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Australia. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
